quote.text: If a great man falls and remains great as he lies, people no more despise him than they stamp on a fallen temple, which the devout still worship as much as when it was standing.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood: Even when our children stumble or face setbacks, their inherent worth remains untarnished—a fallen moment doesn't erase a lifetime of potential and goodness.
  • Parenthood: Like a revered temple, the character and values we instill endure beyond transient failures, reminding us to nurture resilience and unconditional love regardless of temporary falls.
  • Leadership: A leader’s influence is rooted not solely in consistent success but in the wisdom forged through adversity; even in moments of failure, the essence of their guidance can continue to inspire others.
  • Leadership: Embracing setbacks as part of a greater legacy encourages leaders to maintain integrity and humility, ensuring that their contributions remain respected—even when they falter.
  • Product Management: In the realm of product management, projects may falter, yet the ideas and innovative spirit behind them retain their power, much like venerable relics that continue to inspire despite decay.
  • Product Management: This wisdom challenges us to see failure not as a final judgment but as a stepping stone; the underlying vision and learning persist, inviting ongoing respect and adaptation in our daily pursuits.
